purpose: Translate the official Fermi product roles and the exact pinned event products into a candidate-neutral request for the missing response-selection, calibration-validity and timing-uncertainty owner fields.

authority_pointers.role: nine-product event byte and provenance parent
event-day position/attitude and spectral-history owner candidates
candidate-neutral Delta_t_det and four-stage map contract

official_source_references.supporting_scope: GS-005 is the GBM gain/energy-resolution history required for calculating DRMs; GS-006 is the Fermi position/attitude history used in the response pipeline.
official_source_references.use_boundary: Role and provenance crosswalk only; no source likelihood or uncertainty is inferred.

official_source_references.supporting_scope: A GBM response is detector, source-position and time specific; an rsp2 file contains multiple DRMs for changing pointing and energy-channel response.
official_source_references.use_boundary: Semantic interpretation of the local rsp2 headers only; no matrix value, interpolation choice or likelihood is admitted.

official_source_references.supporting_scope: Product-format and response/leaf-file naming context for source lineage.
official_source_references.use_boundary: Format reference only; no numerical response or physical inference.

exact_scope.finite_scope: Finite source-role and owner-field contract only; no table-value reading, likelihood evaluation, continuum, physical identity or prospective validation.
forbidden_actions: Do not treat rsp2 segment numbering or header coverage as a calibration-validity or interpolation law.
Do not treat GS-005/GS-006 role descriptions as a detector-to-geocenter timing correction or uncertainty.
Do not read response/EBOUNDS values or select a segment after observing a candidate residual.
Do not populate F_reg, F_lim, F_eff, F_obs, a score or a prospective lock before the required owner fields are frozen.

response_selection: A versioned rule mapping each event detector and analysis time window to one rsp2 segment or a specified interpolation of segments.
The source-position, spacecraft-attitude and ephemeris inputs used by the mapping, with validity intervals and interpolation rules.
The response-generator and leaf/atmospheric-scattering input versions, including the response product linkage to the selected PHA/CSPEC data.
The channel-to-energy and gain-history calibration version, validity interval and uncertainty for each detector.
time_coordinate: A common time standard and versioned TT/MET/GPS/geocenter conversion including leap-second or clock-correction data.
A detector-to-geocenter timing algorithm with uncertainty and an explicit treatment of spacecraft position/attitude interpolation.
The GW strain calibration and merger-time estimator owner, with its valid time range and uncertainty.
The GBM onset, background and detector/energy window owner, including selection and missing-data rules.
statistical_owner: A joint timing likelihood or an explicitly source-owned covariance with component and shared calibration/source terms.
An intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance law or a preregistered set-valued scoring rule.
A numerical error budget and candidate-neutral F_reg output schema.
holdout_and_proof_split: A prospective holdout sealed before candidate, segment, window or scorer tuning.
Separate proof-owner fields for filtration, heat-root, current intertwiner and one-use ledgers; proof choices cannot fill physical-owner fields.

acceptance_for_owner_submission: Each required field has a source owner, version, validity interval, locator and hash or an independently reproducible implementation.
The response-segment choice or interpolation is fixed before candidate residuals are inspected and is reproducible from the frozen event window.
The timing standard, detector-to-geocenter correction and uncertainty are common to all candidate comparisons.
The likelihood/covariance and intrinsic-lag treatment are source-owned or explicitly preregistered, with no post-disclosure tuning.
A candidate-neutral F_reg artefact is independently reproduced before any F_lim/F_eff/F_obs work.
falsifiers: No owner supplies the response-segment validity/interpolation and calibration linkage.
The geocenter conversion or uncertainty changes with candidate labels or cannot be independently reproduced.
The only available statistical object is a retrospective fitted summary without a source likelihood/covariance.
A required field can be filled only by a proof-owner convention rather than a physical owner.
evidence_level: T0 official-source semantic crosswalk plus hash-pinned local owner candidates; no model or statistical test
next_action: Use this request contract to locate or obtain the versioned response-segment validity/interpolation, calibration linkage, detector-to-geocenter conversion and uncertainty owner artefacts. Keep all response values and scoring locked; independently reproduce F_reg only after acceptance fields are frozen.
non_claims: This is not a likelihood, covariance, calibration-validity law, detector timing correction, candidate map or prediction.
Official product-role documentation and local rsp2 headers do not identify microscopic dynamics or establish a QFT/Yang-Mills/gravity correspondence.
No Pre-A, C6, A13, Sector-A, continuum, physical-vacuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim follows.
The established T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods, owner order and stopped-loop rules are preserved rather than replaced.
